notes.title: Version 1.01 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello players,
This update focuses on balance adjustments and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]When switching characters in and out of formation, rapidly clicking could cause multiple switches.[/p][p]Achievements from the New Folder could still be obtained even after dying.[/p][p]Status effects were not displayed when upgrading character ultimate skills.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Negative status effect [i]Blind Faith[/i]: damage per stack reduced from 25 → 15.[/p][p]The Fairy Monarch (Normal Difficulty): petrification stacks reduced from 6 → 4.[/p][p]Adjustments made to the visual effects of the New Folder’s skills.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.01 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone. Due to some issues, the update speed is relatively slow recently, but please rest assured that we will continue to update.[/p][p]If you have any questions or want to tell us, please feel free to write to us![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Debug[/b][/p][p]Challenge: Herogue Auto Chess Resa's special move caused the game to be unable to continue the error correction[/p][p][/p][p]Hero:Justice Warrior Upgrade Option: Justice: Absorb cannot properly absorb the negative status of teammates on both sides. Correction[/p][p][/p][p]Hero: Number Four Upgrade Option: Self-Sacrifice cannot properly give shields to other teammates. Correction[/p][p]Relic: Brick effect description correction[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Adjustment[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 3 Boss: Mr. Error's battle music volume adjustment[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Expected update:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 2 New Boss: Three Musketeers[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.004 update
notes.content:
[b][UI Updates][/b]
Some UI updates and changes have been made. More updates will follow in the future.

[b][Balance][/b]
The chance of receiving common rarity options when upgrading after level 9 has been reduced.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
Fixed certain issues with incorrect damage display.

notes.title: Version 1.004 update
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fairy Monarch's healing display is incorrect

Enemy shield skill incorrectly applies Weak

notes.title: Version 1.003 update
notes.content:
[b]UI Adjustments[/b]
Skill cost display made clearer
Upgraded portrait color adjustments
Font weight and size adjustments for certain elements
Added status compendium to the character selection menu

[b]Animation Adjustments[/b]

Adjusted animation for the hero "Sheeva"

[b]Balance[/b]

Hero "Russ" upgrade option: Preservatives quality changed to Rare (Grants an extra 1 stack of Infection at the start of battle.)

Hero "Houdini" Shadower skill: Initial debuff removal changed to 3 stacks

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed some translation errors

notes.title: Version 1.002 Update
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]

Increased the difficulty of Ascension 4: All enemies in Ascension 4 now have higher damage and health.

Hero Russ upgrade option: Reduced the poison bonus granted by the passive ability.

Hero Russ: The Spice Magic skill now applies 3 stacks of Venom instead of 4.

Adjusted the damage of some enemies.

notes.title: Version 1.001 update
notes.content:
[b]Optimization[/b]

UI: Improved skill description box transparency.

[b]Balance[/b]

Chapter 3 Elite Enemy – Flesh Sniper: Now applies Burn and Poison with its attacks.

[b]Fixes[/b]

Post-battle damage statistics: Fixed an issue where certain skills caused incorrect damage numbers.
